steps.name: Enforce coverage and generate Clover report

coverage.console_rounding: One decimal; Clover statement ratio below supplies the exact numerator and denominator.

mutation.zero_status_note: The completed summary omits zero-valued uncovered/pending categories. The displayed nonzero categories sum exactly to the separately logged generated total.
mutation.duration_scope_note: Plugin reports mutation execution duration separately from the GitHub step, which also includes initial suite/coverage and mutant generation. No application runtime or speedup is inferred.

score_method_evidence.separate_formula: completed non-timeout detection share = 100 * tested / total
score_method_evidence.total_definition: tested + timeout + untested + uncovered + pending; do not omit nonzero uncovered/pending categories
score_method_evidence.classification_note: Pest Tested means a completed mutant process returned nonzero; Timeout is separate; Untested means the process succeeded. This is tool outcome accounting, not individual semantic triage of every mutant.
score_method_evidence.limit: The completed coverage/mutation job log confirms installation of v4.0.1, matching the locally inspected package version. The source revision and source SHA256 values above describe the locally inspected installed package; they are not a separate remote vendor-tree digest. Current numerical accounting is recorded in coverage-mutation-summary.json.

log_preservation: The complete connector-decoded log is saved as UTF-8 bytes with the returned BOM, ANSI escapes, timestamps and line endings. Excerpts below strip ANSI sequences and join lines with LF; no content within their stated spans is omitted.

limits: These are observations of one completed GitHub Actions run at the exact head above; no CI restart or code/test/configuration changes were made by this observer.

The source coverage figures are from the PHP 8.4/PCOV job only. They do not establish PHP 8.5 or branch coverage; Clover reports zero conditionals, which means no branch-coverage measurement is supplied here.
Pest marks a completed non-successful mutant process as tested. The tested count is tool-reported detection, not an independent semantic RED validation of every mutant.
The reported MSI credits 57 timeouts. The separate 87.46% share is 3716 completed tested outcomes divided by all 4249 mutants; timeout stays in the denominator and is not credited in the numerator.
The 476 untested mutants survived the configured process. This observation does not classify them as equivalent mutations, test gaps, or production defects.
The fully audited manual witness set in the report is distinct from the generated 4249-mutant CI population.
No statistical performance or application speedup conclusion follows from any duration in this evidence.
